release_notes: Themes now include a richer paint-style Color Studio, refreshed branding, and updated launcher icons across Android, iPhone, iPad, and Windows sources.
Sign-in and sign-up are lighter on phones, OTP verification is more reliable, and home is further decluttered with quick links and tighter status cards.
Android updates continue to target the single latest APK path so users no longer have to sift through older release assets.
